title: Scam
body:
The subscription starts at $1 for the first month, but after that it becomes impossible to cancel.
The option is hidden behind a terrible UI and requires an extra external login, which doesn’t even work—so you literally cannot cancel the subscription.
For me, this crosses the line into fraud.
I’m honestly sick of these money-grabbing apps.
The app itself looks nice, but even getting started is frustrating because of the overly complicated, annoying UX flow.
Whoever designed the UX should be ashamed.

title: App deducted money from my bank account without consent
body: I downloaded it just to try out and deleted shortly after. A few weeks later it deducted 90$ from my account and it turned out I was subscribed to two of their packages, although I never answered their emails about confirming any subscriptions. Even after cancelling and starting refound process today it tried to take money from my account again. I searched online and multiple people had these same issuses with them. It is a real working app like all the other ADHD scheduling apps, but with these non consensual automatic payments it’s as close to a scam as it gets. They refound the payments if you contact them but still very sketchy.
